title: Dissecting Bias in LLMs: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Text completion tasks using sentence structures containing nationality names. Bias is quantified by computing the difference in probabilities between positive and negative sentiment next-token predictions, evaluated using a Distilbert model.

Text completion tasks using prompts with profession names. Bias is measured by comparing the sum of probabilities for male-stereotypical versus female-stereotypical next-token predictions based on a predefined vocabulary list.
